title: Certified Countermodels in Profile and Incidence Fibres of Diamond-Induced Edge Partitions
summary: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite loopless directed graph. Each directed two-step diamond identifies its two pairs of opposite edges, and the connected components of the resulting auxiliary graph on $E$ define a canonical partition $Π_{\mathrm{opp}}(G)$. We ask whether a finite relational certificate built from the blocks of an edge partition identifies this canonical partition.
